mcqs.q: The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, gave constitutional status to municipalities and added which Part and Schedule to the Constitution?

options.A: Nagar Panchayat, Municipal Council, and Municipal Corporation
options.B: Town Panchayat, City Council, and Metropolitan Council
options.C: Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, and Zila Parishad

options.A: Always by direct election by the people
options.B: Always by the elected members from amongst themselves
options.C: As provided by the State Legislature by law, which may be by direct election or by election from amongst the elected members

options.C: One‑fourth of the total number of seats

options.A: Five years from the date of its first meeting

options.B: The State Election Commission appointed by the Governor

options.A: By the Governor at his pleasure

options.A: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India

options.C: No reservation is allowed for backward classes.

options.A: A minimum of one‑third and states can provide more

options.D: One‑half as per the constitutional amendment

options.B: Constitution of a District Planning Committee

options.A: The Chairperson is always directly elected by the people.
options.B: The Chairperson is elected by members from amongst themselves.
options.C: The mode of election is determined by the State Legislature.
options.D: The Chairperson is appointed by the Governor.

The State Finance Commission for Municipalities makes recommendations on: 1. Distribution of net proceeds of taxes, duties, tolls and fees between the State and Municipalities. 2. options.A: Only the territorial area of a Municipal Corporation
options.B: The territorial area of a Municipality as notified by the Governor
options.C: Any area designated by the Parliament

mcqs.q: Which of the following is a discretionary provision under the 74th Amendment?

options.B: The 73rd Amendment deals with Municipalities, while the 74th deals with Panchayats.

options.D: Both provide for direct election of the Chairperson.

mcqs.q: The 74th Amendment Act, 1992, was enacted to give effect to which of the following Directive Principles?

options.A: Article 38 – State to secure a social order
options.D: There is no specific Directive Principle for Municipalities; it was based on the need for strengthening urban local governance.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is a subject included in the Twelfth Schedule?

options.B: Water supply for domestic, industrial and commercial purposes

options.A: Based on their proportion to the total population of the state.
options.B: Based on their proportion to the population of the municipal area.
